source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, statuses RECRUITING and NOT_YET_RECRUITING

excluded.reason: Esophageal cancer risk registry; achalasia is only one of many qualifying conditions.
Registry open to any rare disease, not specific to these conditions.
About stomach drainage during esophagus removal surgery, not about these conditions.
About dumping syndrome in children born with esophageal atresia.

trials.title: Per Oral Endoscopic Myotomy (POEM) and Prolonged Dilatation (PRD) for Achalasia
trials.summary: Follows people with achalasia and related problems treated with POEM, prolonged balloon dilation or keyhole surgery, to compare how each works.

trials.title: Cricopharyngeal Dysfunction and Esophageal Diverticulum
trials.summary: Follows people treated for a Zenker's pouch or a tight cricopharyngeus, either through the neck or through the mouth, including people who are not having surgery.

trials.title: Endoscopic Treatment for Zenker's Diverticulum
trials.summary: Records how people do after a flexible endoscopic cut of the wall between a Zenker's pouch and the esophagus.

trials.title: Advanced Endo-therapeutic Procedure : Registry-based Observational Study
trials.summary: A registry of advanced endoscopic procedures at one Montreal hospital, including treatment of Zenker's pouches.
trials.sponsor: Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM)

trials.title: Peroral Endoscopic Myotomy for the Treatment of Achalasia
trials.summary: A registry of people with achalasia treated with POEM at one Dallas hospital.

trials.title: Comprehensive Esophageal Diagnostics Study
trials.summary: Takes small muscle samples and FLIP measurements in people with achalasia and related problems, to see how scarring in the muscle relates to how the sphincter behaves.

trials.title: Onabotulinum Toxin A (Botox) in the Treatment of Pharyngo-esophageal Dysphagia
trials.summary: Tests Botox injected into the upper sphincter against a placebo for swallowing trouble caused by a tight cricopharyngeus, mostly after stroke and other nerve conditions.
trials.sponsor: All India Institute of Medical Sciences

trials.title: VZV in the Enteric Nervous System: Pathogenesis and Consequences
trials.summary: Tests whether an antiviral drug and the shingles vaccine help people whose achalasia is linked to an ongoing chickenpox virus infection in the nerves of the esophagus.

trials.title: Routine Versus Symptomatic Protein Pump Inhibitor Therapy for Prevention of Gastroesophageal Reflux After Per Oral Endoscopic Myotomy for Esophageal Achalasia
trials.summary: Compares taking acid medicine every day after POEM with taking it only when symptoms appear, to see which better prevents reflux.

trials.title: Prospective Evaluation of the Clinical Utility of Peroral Endoscopic Myotomy for Gastrointestinal Motility Disorders
trials.summary: Records outcomes for everyone treated with POEM at one Orlando hospital, including achalasia, spasm and Zenker's.

trials.title: Randomized Controlled Study of Optical 3D Navigated Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Achalasia.
trials.summary: Tests magnetic stimulation of the brain, with no surgery, as a treatment for achalasia, against a sham version.

trials.title: POEM-F for Achalasia International Study
trials.summary: Compares standard POEM with POEM plus a wrap made from the inside, to see if the wrap reduces reflux afterwards.

trials.title: Electrosurgical Modes for Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection in Peroral Endoscopic Esophageal Myotomy
trials.summary: Compares two electrical settings used during POEM to see which is safer and quicker.

trials.title: MARIMPACH : Contribution of High-resolution Manometry With Impedancemetry for the Evaluation of Esophageal Clearance in Achalasia
trials.summary: Compares a pressure-and-flow test with a timed barium X-ray for measuring how well the esophagus empties after achalasia treatment.

trials.title: Effects of Malnutrition on Respiratory and Renal Functions in Patients Undergoing Peroral Endoscopic Myotomy (POEM)
trials.summary: Looks at how poor nutrition affects breathing and kidney function during anesthesia for POEM.

trials.title: Endoscopic Treatment of Zenker's Diverticulum (ZENKTUN)
trials.summary: Compares Z-POEM with other endoscopic treatments for Zenker's pouches across French centres, looking at how often symptoms come back after a year.

trials.title: Standard Versus Oesophago-gastric Junction Complex Myotomy for Treatment naïve Type 2 Achalasia Patients
trials.summary: Compares a shorter, more targeted POEM cut with the standard cut in people with type II achalasia who have not been treated before.

trials.title: Evolution of the Chicago Classification: Bridging Physiology and Mechanics
trials.summary: Uses pressure tests, FLIP and a gut-motility drug to understand how the esophagus moves in people with swallowing trouble, including achalasia.

trials.title: Comparison of Balloon Dilatation and Per Oral Endoscopic Myotomy in Children With Achalasia Cardia
trials.summary: Compares balloon dilation with POEM in children aged 3 to 17 with achalasia.

trials.title: Sling-Fiber Preservation POEM vs. Conventional POEM for Reducing Post-POEM GERD
trials.summary: Compares standard POEM with a version that spares some muscle fibres at the stomach, to see if it causes less reflux.

trials.title: The Use of Indocyanine Green Fluorescence (ICG) During Laparoscopic Heller- Dor
trials.summary: Tests whether a fluorescent dye during Heller myotomy helps surgeons spot small tears in the lining.

trials.title: Comparative Study of Per-oral Endoscopic Myotomy (POEM) in Treatment - naïve Achalasia Patients Versus Patients With Previous Pneumatic Dilation
trials.summary: Compares how POEM works in people with achalasia who have never been treated and people who have already had balloon dilation.

trials.title: PREcision MEDicine In Achalasia (PREMEDIA)
trials.summary: A large US trial testing whether a shorter, tailored POEM cut works as well as the standard cut for achalasia types I and II, with less reflux.

trials.title: PREcision MEDicine In Achalasia (PREMEDIA) - Cohort
trials.summary: A US study following people with type III achalasia, jackhammer esophagus and related spastic problems, to see whether testing before POEM helps doctors choose how long to cut.

trials.title: Comparison of Conventional and Short Submucosal Tunnel Techniques in Type II Achalasia
trials.summary: Compares the standard POEM tunnel with two shorter versions in people with type II achalasia.

trials.title: Metabolic Changes Associated With Weight Gain After Treatment of Achalasia
trials.summary: Measures metabolic changes, such as blood sugar and cholesterol, in people who regain weight after achalasia treatment.

trials.title: Safety and Efficacy of a Novel SpydrBlade Flexible Bipolar in POEM
trials.summary: Tests a new cutting device for POEM.

trials.title: Transverse vs Longitudinal Mucosal Incision During POEM
trials.summary: Compares two ways of making the first opening in the lining during POEM.

trials.title: Clinical Outcomes, Safety, and Effectiveness of Speedboat UltraSlim™ in Per-Oral Endoscopic Myotomy (POEM)
trials.summary: Records outcomes of POEM done with a particular surgical device at one Houston hospital.

trials.title: PRospective Registry of Esophageal Motility
trials.summary: A large Italian registry of people having esophageal pressure tests, including people with achalasia.

trials.title: Short Versus Long Submucosal Tunneling in Per-oral Endoscopic Myotomy (POEM) for Type II Achalasia.
trials.summary: Compares short and long tunnels during POEM in people with type II achalasia.

trials.title: Impact of Body Positioning on EndoFLIP Measurements: A Comparative Study of Supine and Left Lateral Decubitus Positions
trials.summary: Checks whether lying on your back or your side changes FLIP measurements, in children and young adults aged 5 to 21.

trials.title: POEM Versus Laparoscopic Heller Myotomy With Dor Fundoplication for Esophageal Achalasia
trials.summary: Compares POEM with Heller myotomy plus a Dor wrap for achalasia.
